_meta.description: Four geographically separated lunar sites with sourced coordinates. Elevation is sampled from global NASA LOLA LDEM_4; slope from global LDSM_16; illumination is an explicit ideal-horizon gameplay model; polar LEND hydrogen is unavailable at these coordinates.
_meta.how_to_fill: Refresh NASA LOLA elevation/slope when newer or finer global products are selected. For illumination, record a NASA layer, period, coordinate, and sampling method or replace the disclosed geometric model. Do not infer polar LEND hydrogen values at nonpolar sites.

sites.name: Tranquility Base (Apollo 11)
sites.description: Historic Apollo 11 landing location in Mare Tranquillitatis. Global LOLA terrain values are sampled at the documented coordinate; illumination is modeled and polar hydrogen data are unavailable here.

coordinates.source: NASA Apollo Landing Sites chart (2023), Apollo 11 / Mare Tranquillitatis; 0.67416°N, 23.47314°E. https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/south-pole.pdf

illumination_pct.source: Geometric model assumption: 50% sun visibility averaged over a full lunar day at non-polar latitude, with a level horizon. This is not a sampled NASA illumination raster and excludes local terrain horizons; use as a gameplay baseline only.

elevation_m.source: NASA PDS LRO LOLA GDR v1.0 LDEM_4 (global, 4 pixels/degree; 7.58084 km/pixel), sampled from the pixel containing this coordinate. DN × 0.5 m; height relative to the 1,737.4 km reference sphere, not geoid-corrected elevation. https://pds.nasa.gov/ds-view/pds/viewProfile.jsp?dsid=LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
elevation_m.sample_method: Nearest containing pixel; zero-based row/column [357, 93]; pixel center lat/lon [0.625, 23.375] degrees

slope_deg.source: NASA PDS LRO LOLA GDR v1.0 LDSM_16 (product v2.0), global slope map at 16 pixels/degree (1.89521 km/pixel; 240 m slope baseline), sampled from the pixel containing this coordinate. Slope = DN × 0.0015 + 45 degrees. https://pds.nasa.gov/ds-view/pds/viewProfile.jsp?dsid=LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
slope_deg.sample_method: Containing pixel; zero-based row/column [1429, 375]; pixel center lat/lon [0.65625, 23.46875] degrees

hydrogen_ppm.availability_note: No applicable LEND polar estimate at this latitude
hydrogen_ppm.source: Not available: the cited NASA LEND regional near-surface hydrogen estimate covers latitudes above 88° north or south; these site coordinates are outside that region. No point value is inferred.
